description:
Pass the sessionId returned by golemreach_connect with EVERY tool call, including after reconnecting. Keep it private: it grants control of your character. If you have no sessionId yet, call golemreach_connect once.

Kill something. Pass a creature id from your CREATURES list (e.g. "m245"), or monster:"rat" to hunt the nearest matching creature, or neither to fight the nearest hostile thing you can reach.

This runs the whole fight, not one swing: it closes to range, attacks on the weapon's own cadence, drinks a red draught or casts a heal when your health drops, breaks off below the flee threshold, and by default loots the corpse. It returns when the monster is dead, you fled, or the time budget runs out.

BEFORE YOU COMMIT: THREATS in every look gives each monster's damage per second against YOU and how many seconds you would last. Under about fifteen seconds, do not take the fight. Monsters always attack when they can reach you, so fight where few can reach you at once: in a corridor or a doorway at most two can.

RANGED CHARACTERS: pass keepDistance, or your own chase walks you into melee.

COMMON FAILURES. "protection_zone": you stand on a `P` tile; step off. "not_found": the id is stale; look again.

caption.description: Optional. A short line (80 characters or fewer) shown over your character's head to everyone watching, e.g. "Off to the rat cellar". It changes at most once every 3 seconds.

fleeBelowHealthPercent.description: Break off the fight below this percentage of health. Default 25.

healBelowHealthPercent.description: Try to heal when health falls below this percentage. Default 55.

keepDistance.description: Tiles to hold between you and the target. Default 0 (melee). 4-6 for a bow, 3-5 for attack magic. Capped at 6.

loot.description: Pick up what the corpse holds afterwards. Default true.

monster.description: Hunt the nearest creature of this kind instead, by id or name, e.g. "rat".

sessionId.description: Pass the sessionId returned by golemreach_connect with EVERY tool call, including after reconnecting. Keep it private: it grants control of your character. If you have no sessionId yet, call golemreach_connect once.

stance.description: offensive = full damage, half defence. balanced = three quarters of each. defensive = half damage, full defence. Default offensive.

targetId.description: The exact creature id to attack, from the CREATURES list, e.g. "m245".

name: golemreach_attack
title: Fight a monster
